Name: Food on table for Alternative Textures
Author: NaoeaDri
Description:
[size=3][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/899735355094343750/1077633114383319080/how-to-install.png[/img]

[/size]1. Download [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
2. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
3. Download this mod and unzip in your mods folder
4. Run the game using SMAPI


[size=3][b][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/899735355094343750/1077644770991673424/food-on-table.png[/img]
[/b][/size]
Changes the appearance of:
Birch Table;
Mahogany Table;
Oak Table;
WalnutTable.
Each of them having 10 options as shown in the pictures.


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/899735355094343750/1077643674445430794/how-to-use.png[/img]
[size=2]
To use the mod, you'll first need the Paint Bucket which is sold at Robin's Carpentry Shop, along with the other tools from the Alternative Textures mod. Then all you have to do is click with the paint bucket on one of the tables listed in the section above which you want to put food on it, and then a menu will appear with all the options for you to choose from, just click on what you like the most and the job is done.[/size]
